reuse.why: Adds the check next to the existing findOrCreateBank in link.ts and uses the existing db.first helper, calling it from all five provider link functions.

duplication.why: The rule itself is defined once; only the one-call invocation is repeated in each of the five already-duplicated provider link functions.

placement.why: The shared linking rule lives in accounts/link.ts, the module the tree already uses for link-time bank logic, and the handlers only call it.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites, focused tests and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: Clear, documented single helper; a new provider must remember to call it, as with findOrCreateBank, because the link functions remain parallel copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link functions go through link.assertBankAccountNotLinked; no path re-implements the query.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the repeated lines are calls to one helper.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts defines the rule (provider + account_id, not tombstoned, not the upgrading account); every provider link path calls it.
